capabilities: Run system shells and installed CLI tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex) in tabbed terminals
Continuously save each terminal session to a per-tab Markdown backup beside the current document
Toggle per-tab note syncing and recover from conflicts using raw JSONL session logs
Export readable Markdown and generate compact copies of older records
Customize fonts, colors, line height and layout for the terminal and note panes
disambiguation: Not an AI agent itself; it runs whatever CLI you have installed in a plain shell and only records the session output to notes.
extras: Interface labels are currently Chinese-only. The Windows graphical interface has not been manually tested (macOS is verified; Windows backend runs in CI). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Raw logs in .agent-note-terminal/ can contain echoed drafts or sensitive values even when omitted from the readable note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, and terminal or CLI agent sessions normally vanish when closed, leaving no searchable record inside the vault.
